title: Authentication: email/password login, logout, protected routes (001-authentication)
description: Implement the 001-authentication feature per specs/001-authentication/. Stateless JWT auth (HS256, 24h), bcrypt(cost 12) password hashing, Express+Prisma+PostgreSQL backend (Repository Pattern), React 19 + Vite frontend (feature-first). TDD per constitution Principle I. Three user stories: US1 Secure Login (P1/MVP), US2 Secure Logout (P2), US3 Protected Access & Session Expiry (P3). See specs/001-authentication/tasks.md for the 54-task decomposition.
design: JWT stateless sessions (research.md); bcrypt cost 12; client-side logout token discard; zod validation; generic 401 to prevent enumeration; express-rate-limit for brute-force; Authorization Bearer header transport.
acceptance_criteria: All acceptance scenarios in spec.md pass; SC-001..SC-007 met; no passwordHash/plaintext in any response or log; quickstart.md validation green; all automated tests pass; TS strict (no any), ESLint/Prettier clean.
